purpose: Cross-session prior-art and experiment navigation for SchemaRouter open-set capability routing research.
session_bootstrap: Search existing open/closed issues and research branches before creating a new experiment.
Resume the first active workstream/experiment; do not recreate terminal methods.
invariants: Registered schema-backed routes are the only source of positive execution authority.
Open-set methods may preserve the raw registered winner or abstain to NO_ROUTE; they may not invent a route.
No route-specific retraining for newly registered OpenAPI/MCP tools.

Datatype, semantic_id, optional unit, canonical unit normalization, dimension, qualifiers, read/write/destructive metadata remain part of the typed capability graph independently of the open-set method.
Consumed DEV/fresh/confirmation rows may not be used to repair a terminal method.
